title: Lithuania and Ukraine move drone and electronic-warfare cooperation toward a planned local production route
source_unit: Lithuanian Ministry of National Defence account of a Lithuanian-Ukrainian industrial cooperation letter of intent
geography: Lithuania, Ukraine, and European defence-industrial supply chains

observations.period: October 15, 2026; planned Lithuanian-Ukrainian drone and electronic-warfare production cooperation

denominator.unit: signed letter of intent between Pekkla UAB and Ukraine's December One RND Ltd

cooperation_scope.value: The parties reported cooperation on production and supply of electronic-warfare systems and UAV components

planned_lithuanian_joint_venture.value: The Lithuanian defence minister stated that the aim was to establish a joint venture in Lithuania and start production in 2027

stated_state_capability_mechanism.value: Lithuania described local production as shortening logistics chains, strengthening the national economy, and improving industrial resilience and independence

realized_production_and_effect.unit: missing joint-venture formation, factory commissioning, production volume, delivered systems, accepted capability, workforce count, cost, and operational effect

observations.method: Bounded extraction from the Lithuanian Ministry of National Defence account; the signed letter of intent and stated 2027 plan are retained separately from realized industrial output or military capability.
observations.uncertainty: The account does not provide a binding production contract, investment amount, ownership structure, facility identifier, production schedule beyond the stated target year, quantity, delivery, acceptance, or independent feasibility evidence.
observations.subgroup: Pekkla UAB, December One RND Ltd, Lithuanian and Ukrainian defence institutions, future industrial workers, and European UAV/electronic-warfare supply chains.
observations.counterinterpretation: A letter of intent can signal strategic alignment and a possible supply-chain option without becoming a funded, operating, or cost-competitive production facility.

related_sources.claim: A related October 13 Lithuanian-Polish account describes a Piorun acquisition in its final stage and discusses air-defence and counter-UAV cooperation.
related_sources.access_boundary: The Piorun procurement route and this industrial letter of intent are distinct; neither establishes the other's delivery or production outcome.

boundary: This record establishes a reported industrial-cooperation plan and a stated 2027 production target. It does not establish a joint venture, factory operation, delivered systems, accepted military capability, economic benefit, or reduced external dependence.
